scope: Supplement to the already-sent joint-plan reconciliation; no runtime or activation authority.

typetrix_purge_contract.retained_payload: P0 is the original pre-image needed for restoration; P1 is its verified forward post-image used as an undo guard. Keep these and target/range/revision evidence only for eligible unrestored items in the bounded undo phase; purge unrelated context.
typetrix_purge_contract.queued_callback_rule: Queued callbacks carry immutable operation/generation/request IDs, not copies of P0/P1 or the batch. Claims are single-use.
invalidators: External new typing or uncertain edit provenance
typetrix_purge_contract.ordering: Serialize invalidation with entry into each host mutation. Revoke the old generation before detaching payloads and prevent new leases. A generation check followed by an unprotected gap before writing is insufficient. Recheck ownership after reentrant host calls and before further writes.

state_event_matrix.effect: Revoke generation and release owner-held P0/P1 and anchors. Undo becomes unavailable.

state_event_matrix.state: Callback queued or withheld; no host primitive executing
state_event_matrix.effect: Revoke and release immediately; retain only non-text request lifecycle metadata. Late callback is a no-op with zero inverse writes. Cleanup cannot depend on callback arrival.

state_event_matrix.state: Validation host primitive entered; inverse write not entered
state_event_matrix.effect: Release owner-held payloads. A buffer borrowed by the active validation primitive survives only until return, then is released. No inverse write follows.

Purge unborrowed data; retain only that primitive's minimal lifetime-safe lease until return. The entered call may finish. No later write, readback, compensation or rearm follows; restoration stays unverified unless verification had already been accepted.
Revoke and purge, except buffers already borrowed by an active verification primitive until return. Stale verification cannot upgrade the restoration count.
Keep the historical verified-restored count, purge images. That count is not a claim about current text after later edits.

typetrix_purge_contract.replacement_rule: Detach the old operation before publishing its successor. If an old mutation is in flight, defer successor capture/write preparation until return, then obtain fresh evidence. Old completions cannot alter or clear successor state.
typetrix_purge_contract.targeting_rule: Never redirect an old callback to a newly focused field; returning focus does not revive the old generation. Do not confuse demonstrably operation-owned notifications with external typing.
typetrix_purge_contract.purge_definition: Logical purge removes retrievable application-owned payload references, releasing active call-scoped leases at their first safe boundary. It is not proof of physical zeroization from allocators, immutable strings, host buffers, OS storage or crash dumps.
typetrix_purge_contract.privacy: No raw text or text hashes in telemetry, logs or retained callback metadata.
proposed_fixtures: For each invalidator, withhold a callback, invalidate, then deliver it: zero inverse writes, no retrievable payload, no rearm, successor unchanged.
Never deliver the queued callback: no retained text in operation/callback storage after invalidation.
Trigger invalidation from a validation call: safe buffer lifetime until return, then release, no inverse write.
Invalidate immediately before versus immediately after write entry: before gives zero writes; after permits only the already-entered primitive, with no follow-on host operation.
Entered host write fully changes, partially changes, fails after change, or fails without change: no rollback claim or retry, and no verified-restored increment without accepted verification.
Invalidate before versus after verification acceptance: unverified attempt versus one historical verified restoration; neither rearms.
Replace A with B, then deliver A's late/duplicate callbacks and restore old focus: no resurrection or mutation of B.
Interrupt batch after k verified restorations: report k plus separate not-attempted and attempted-unverified counts; not-attempted does not prove unchanged text.
typetrix_purge_contract.validation: Proposed application contract and fixtures only. No implementation or fixture execution; earlier 22-fixture results do not validate these cases.

queue_review_request.scope: Review the proposed 60–120-minute offline fix/test chunk before treating it as execution scope.
tests_to_include: Exact duplicate versus different valid content for the same sender/key, within a batch and against persisted state.
Conflict evidence remains durable and cursor/admission transitions stay atomic.
Success and HTTP-error bodies at, below and above the byte limit, with missing or misleading Content-Length.
Detect over-limit data before parse using a bounded limit-plus-one read or equivalent; reading exactly the limit alone cannot establish that no extra bytes exist.
Malformed JSON and restart/replay behavior, using synthetic fixtures without live service contact.
queue_review_request.request: Confirm or refine the expected tests and approach; retain the existing schema priority. No transport activation or new access is requested.

presence_status: Expiring preparation/presence semantics remain unimplemented; no exact expiry policy or live-activity guarantee is agreed.
